subject: Math
skill: Ratios Rates Proportional Relationships And Units
prompt: A computer printer uses $1$ cartridge of black ink to print $12$ reams of paper. One ream contains $500$ sheets of paper. If a business needs to print $27,000$ sheets of paper, how many cartridges of black ink does the printer use?
explanation: First, convert sheets to reams: $27{,}000$ sheets $\div 500$ sheets per ream $= 54$ reams. Then, use the rate: $1$ cartridge prints $12$ reams, so the number of cartridges needed is $54$ reams $\div 12$ reams per cartridge $= 4.5$ cartridges.
